comments.content: Nested ternary expressions are prohibited by the review rules and hurt readability. Replace with a flat if/else-if chain so each dry-run reason is unambiguous and easy to scan.

Duplicate/redundant payload: both `dest` and `destination` are set to the same value (`dest`). This doubles the surface area for consumers and is misleading. Emit one alias consistently (e.g. `destination`) or document why both are required.
comments.suggestion_code:
source: src,
        destination: dest,
        sourceExists: existsSync(src),
comments.existing_code:
source: src,
        dest,
        destination: dest,
        sourceExists: existsSync(src),
